title: Thai-Style Glazed Chicken
description: Sweet and sticky glazed chicken with a hint of Thai spices. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the gingerly soy sauce, honey, and Mediterranean oregano. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the glaze over the chicken and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
